title: PAN
section: It is mandatory to select at least one of the options, as mentioned in the form. In case of multiple sources of income, more than one option can be selected. [ 10. AO Details](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#33) AO code (Area Code, AO Type, Range Code and AO Number) of the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer must be filled up by the applicant. These details can be obtained from the Income Tax Office or IT PAN Service Centers managed by UTIITSL/Protean or UTIITSL website www.utiitsl.com or Protean website www.tinpan.proteantech.in [ 11. Representative Assessee/ Authorized Representative Name](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#34) [ 12. Permanent Account Number (if any)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#35) PAN of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative is to be given. [ 13. Aadhaar Number/Foreign Passport](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#36) Aadhaar number is mandatory, if PAN of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative is not available. In case of FPIs, Foreign Passport number can be given if PAN and Aadhaar are not available. [ 14. Address of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#37) It is mandatory to provide details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative having Indian address (except FPIs). FPIs can provide foreign address. [ 15. Contact Details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#38) All contact details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative are mandatory.
